content.title: Apple Foldable iPhone: FIRST LOOK + New Details
content.text: Apple’s foldable iPhone just had its biggest leak week yet, and there’s a LOT to unpack. From dummy models and design details to conflicting reports about delays, pricing, and even the name, this is shaping up to be Apple’s most ambitious iPhone ever. In this video, we break down everything we know so far about the foldable iPhone, including: • First look at dummy models and design • Passport-style foldable form factor • 7.8-inch inner display and 5.5-inch outer display • Touch ID replacing Face ID • Ultra-thin 4.5mm design • Possible “iPhone Ultra” branding • $2,000+ expected price • Conflicting reports about launch timing • Production updates from Foxconn • Hinge material decisions and durability concerns With leaks coming from sources like Mark Gurman, Ming-Chi Kuo, and Nikkei Asia, the situation is evolving fast, and the timeline is still unclear. Will Apple launch the foldable iPhone alongside the iPhone 18 Pro this September, or are delays coming?
